knowledge:
- key_parameters: omics=Character vector or list of omics to simulate (e.g., "RNA-seq", "miRNA-seq", "DNase-seq", "ChIP-seq", "Methyl-seq") ;; omicsOptions=List of specific options for each omic generated via omicSim ;; diffGenes=Percentage (0-1) or absolute number (>1) of differentially expressed genes ;; numberGroups=Number of experimental groups/conditions ;; numberReps=Number of replicates per condition ;; times=Vector of time points for time-series designs ;; TFtoGene=Logical or 3-column data frame for transcription factor target associations ;; regulatorEffect=List containing percentages of regulator effect types (repressor, activator, no effect) ;; associationList=Data frame linking regulators/peaks to genes for single-cell or regulatory omics
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when you need to generate synthetic multi-omics datasets (bulk or single-cell) with known ground-truth regulatory relationships and differential expression profiles to benchmark integration pipelines, GRN inference tools, or differential expression/accessibility analysis tools.
- pitfalls: RNA-seq is mandatory and will always be included even if not specified ;; Invalid combinations of experimental design (e.g., 1 group with 1 time point) will cause an error; simulating differential expression requires at least 2 groups with no time points, or 1 group with at least 2 time points ;; Requested regulator effect percentages may be modified/reduced by the algorithm if they are constrained by the number of simulated DEGs (increasing diffGenes can help) ;; For custom data, identifiers between RNA-seq and association lists must match exactly ;; For Methylation, do not provide a seed count sample; only provide the association list with CpG sites formatted as <chr>_<start>_<end> ;; Transcription factors are not simulated if included in the omics list; they must be simulated via the TFtoGene parameter.

workflows.name: bulk_multi_omics_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate bulk multi-omics data (RNA-seq and regulatory omics) using custom or default seed datasets and experimental designs.
input: custom_rnaseq.csv (RNA-seq seed count matrix with "Counts" column and gene IDs as row names)
custom_dnaseseq.csv (DNase-seq seed count matrix with "Counts" column and peak IDs as row names)
dnase_genes.csv (Association table with "ID" and "Gene" columns linking peaks to genes)
custom_tf.csv (Transcription factor association table with "TF", "TFgene", and "LinkedGene" columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare custom seed data and association lists using omicData ;; 2. Define simulation options for each omic using omicSim ;; 3. Run the simulation using mosim ;; 4. Retrieve settings and count matrices using omicSettings and omicResults ;; 5. Generate experimental design matrix using experimentalDesign ;; 6. Plot profiles using plotProfile ;; 7. Discretize regulator data if needed using discretize
workflows.code:
data("sampleData")
custom_rnaseq <- head(sampleData$SimRNAseq$data, 100)
rnaseq_customdata <- omicData("RNA-seq", data = custom_rnaseq)
custom_dnaseseq <- head(sampleData$SimDNaseseq$data, 100)
dnase_genes <- sampleData$SimDNaseseq$idToGene
dnase_genes <- dnase_genes[dnase_genes$ID %in% rownames(custom_dnaseseq), ]
dnaseseq_customdata <- omicData("DNase-seq", data = custom_dnaseseq, associationList = dnase_genes)
custom_tf <- head(sampleData$SimRNAseq$TFtoGene, 100)
multi_simulation <- mosim(omics = list(
    "RNA-seq" = rnaseq_customdata,
    "DNase-seq" = dnaseseq_customdata),
    TFtoGene = custom_tf
    )
omics_list <- c("RNA-seq", "DNase-seq")
omics_options <- c(omicSim("RNA-seq", totalFeatures = 2500, depth = 74),
                   omicSim("DNase-seq",
                           totalFeatures = 1500,
                           regulatorEffect = list(
                                'activator' = 0.68,
                                'repressor' = 0.3,
                                'NE' = 0.02
                            )))
set.seed(12345)
multi_simulation <- mosim(omics = omics_list,
                          omicsOptions = omics_options)
rnaseq_settings <- omicSettings(multi_simulation, "RNA-seq")
all_settings <- omicSettings(multi_simulation)
dnase_settings <- omicSettings(multi_simulation, "DNase-seq",
                               association = TRUE)
rnaseq_simulated <- omicResults(multi_simulation, "RNA-seq")
all_simulated <- omicResults(multi_simulation)
design_matrix <- experimentalDesign(rnaseq_simulation)
discrete_ChIP <- discretize(rnaseq_simulated, "ChIP-seq")

workflows.name: single_cell_multi_omics_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate single-cell multi-omics data (scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq) with custom cell types and regulatory associations.
input: Seurat_obj (Seurat object containing single-cell count data)
associationList.csv (Association table containing peak IDs related to gene names)
workflows.stages: 1. Format input data using sc_omicData ;; 2. Define cell types and load association lists ;; 3. Run single-cell simulation using sc_mosim ;; 4. Retrieve settings and results using sc_omicSettings and sc_omicResults
workflows.code:
library(MOSim)
omicsList <- sc_omicData(list("scRNA-seq", "scATAC-seq"), data = NULL)
cell_types <- list('Treg' = c(1:10),'cDC' = c(11:20),'CD4_TEM' = c(21:30), 'Memory_B' = c(31:40))
data(associationList)
testing_groups <- sc_mosim(
  omicsList,
  cell_types,
  numberReps = 2,
  numberGroups = 3,
  diffGenes = list(c(0.2, 0.3), c(0.2, 0.3)),
  minFC = 0.25,
  maxFC = 4,
  numberCells = NULL,
  mean = NULL,
  sd = NULL,
  regulatorEffect = list(c(0.1, 0.2), c(0.1, 0.2), c(0.1, 0.2)),
  associationList = associationList,
  TF = FALSE
)
scRNA <- MOSim::sc_omicData("scRNA-seq", data = NULL)
count <- scRNA[["scRNA-seq"]]
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")
Seurat_obj <- Seurat::CreateAssayObject(counts = count, assay = 'RNA')
omic_list_user <- sc_omicData(c("scRNA-seq"), data = c(Seurat_obj))
sim <- sc_mosim(omic_list, cell_types, TF = TRUE)
settings <- sc_omicSettings(sim)
settings <- sc_omicSettings(sim, TF = TRUE)
res <- sc_omicResults(sim)
